en.text: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.

zhSimplified.text: 基督释放了我们，叫我们得以自由。所以要站立得稳，不要再被奴仆的轭挟制。

zhTraditional.text: 基督釋放了我們，叫我們得以自由。所以要站立得穩，不要再被奴僕的軛挾制。

en.text: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.

zhSimplified.text: 我—保罗告诉你们，若受割礼，基督就与你们无益了。

zhTraditional.text: 我－保羅告訴你們，若受割禮，基督就與你們無益了。

en.text: Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

zhSimplified.text: 我再指着凡受割礼的人确实地说，他是欠着行全律法的债。

zhTraditional.text: 我再指着凡受割禮的人確實地說，他是欠着行全律法的債。

en.text: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.

zhSimplified.text: 你们这要靠律法称义的，是与基督隔绝，从恩典中坠落了。

zhTraditional.text: 你們這要靠律法稱義的，是與基督隔絕，從恩典中墜落了。

en.text: For we through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.

zhSimplified.text: 我们靠着圣灵，凭着信心，等候所盼望的义。

zhTraditional.text: 我們靠着聖靈，憑着信心，等候所盼望的義。

en.text: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision amounts to anything, but faith working through love.

zhSimplified.text: 原来在基督耶稣里，受割礼不受割礼全无功效，惟独使人生发仁爱的信心才有功效。

zhTraditional.text: 原來在基督耶穌裏，受割禮不受割禮全無功效，惟獨使人生發仁愛的信心才有功效。

en.text: You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?

zhSimplified.text: 你们向来跑得好，有谁拦阻你们，叫你们不顺从真理呢？

zhTraditional.text: 你們向來跑得好，有誰攔阻你們，叫你們不順從真理呢？

en.text: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.

zhSimplified.text: 这样的劝导不是出于那召你们的。

zhTraditional.text: 這樣的勸導不是出於那召你們的。

en.text: A little yeast grows through the whole lump.

zhSimplified.text: 一点面酵能使全团都发起来。

zhTraditional.text: 一點麵酵能使全團都發起來。

en.text: I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.

zhSimplified.text: 我在主里很信你们必不怀别样的心；但搅扰你们的，无论是谁，必担当他的罪名。

zhTraditional.text: 我在主裏很信你們必不懷別樣的心；但攪擾你們的，無論是誰，必擔當他的罪名。

en.text: But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.

zhSimplified.text: 弟兄们，我若仍旧传割礼，为什么还受逼迫呢？若是这样，那十字架讨厌的地方就没有了。

zhTraditional.text: 弟兄們，我若仍舊傳割禮，為甚麼還受逼迫呢？若是這樣，那十字架討厭的地方就沒有了。

en.text: I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.

zhSimplified.text: 恨不得那搅乱你们的人把自己割绝了。

zhTraditional.text: 恨不得那攪亂你們的人把自己割絕了。

en.text: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.

zhSimplified.text: 弟兄们，你们蒙召是要得自由，只是不可将你们的自由当作放纵情欲的机会，总要用爱心互相服事。

zhTraditional.text: 弟兄們，你們蒙召是要得自由，只是不可將你們的自由當作放縱情慾的機會，總要用愛心互相服事。

en.text: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”

zhSimplified.text: 因为全律法都包在「爱人如己」这一句话之内了。

zhTraditional.text: 因為全律法都包在「愛人如己」這一句話之內了。

en.text: But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.

zhSimplified.text: 你们要谨慎，若相咬相吞，只怕要彼此消灭了。

zhTraditional.text: 你們要謹慎，若相咬相吞，只怕要彼此消滅了。

en.text: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.

zhSimplified.text: 我说，你们当顺着圣灵而行，就不放纵肉体的情欲了。

zhTraditional.text: 我說，你們當順着聖靈而行，就不放縱肉體的情慾了。

en.text: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.

zhSimplified.text: 因为情欲和圣灵相争，圣灵和情欲相争，这两个是彼此相敌，使你们不能做所愿意做的。

zhTraditional.text: 因為情慾和聖靈相爭，聖靈和情慾相爭，這兩個是彼此相敵，使你們不能做所願意做的。

en.text: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

zhSimplified.text: 但你们若被圣灵引导，就不在律法以下。

zhTraditional.text: 但你們若被聖靈引導，就不在律法以下。

en.text: Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,

zhSimplified.text: 情欲的事都是显而易见的，就如奸淫、污秽、邪荡、

zhTraditional.text: 情慾的事都是顯而易見的，就如姦淫、污穢、邪蕩、

en.text: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,

zhSimplified.text: 拜偶像、邪术、仇恨、争竞、忌恨、恼怒、结党、纷争、异端、

zhTraditional.text: 拜偶像、邪術、仇恨、爭競、忌恨、惱怒、結黨、紛爭、異端、

en.text: envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit God’s Kingdom.

zhSimplified.text: 嫉妒、醉酒、荒宴等类。我从前告诉你们，现在又告诉你们，行这样事的人必不能承受 神的国。

zhTraditional.text: 嫉妒、醉酒、荒宴等類。我從前告訴你們，現在又告訴你們，行這樣事的人必不能承受上帝的國。

en.text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,

zhSimplified.text: 圣灵所结的果子，就是仁爱、喜乐、和平、忍耐、恩慈、良善、信实、

zhTraditional.text: 聖靈所結的果子，就是仁愛、喜樂、和平、忍耐、恩慈、良善、信實、

en.text: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

zhSimplified.text: 温柔、节制。这样的事没有律法禁止。

zhTraditional.text: 溫柔、節制。這樣的事沒有律法禁止。

en.text: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.

zhSimplified.text: 凡属基督耶稣的人，是已经把肉体连肉体的邪情私欲同钉在十字架上了。

zhTraditional.text: 凡屬基督耶穌的人，是已經把肉體連肉體的邪情私慾同釘在十字架上了。

en.text: If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.

zhSimplified.text: 我们若是靠圣灵得生，就当靠圣灵行事。

zhTraditional.text: 我們若是靠聖靈得生，就當靠聖靈行事。

en.text: Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.

zhSimplified.text: 不要贪图虚名，彼此惹气，互相嫉妒。

zhTraditional.text: 不要貪圖虛名，彼此惹氣，互相嫉妒。
